name: Assignments
description: Defines an 'assignment' content entity type with configurable bundles, Views data, and standard CRUD permissions; a base module for extensions.
project_description: Assignments is a scaffold-generated base module that declares a custom fieldable content entity type ('assignment') plus a config-entity bundle type ('assignment_type'). Each assignment carries an author reference, a required string field (labelled 'Channel'), and created/changed timestamps, and is managed entirely under Drupal's admin UI at /admin/content/assignment with Field UI and Views integration. Access to view/add/edit/delete assignments is gated by six dedicated permissions plus an admin permission. It ships no external integrations, services, or Drush commands of its own; it is intended as the entity foundation that extension projects (for example assignments_hootsuite) build on. Some form/template code references a 'node' field and helper methods that are not defined by this module's own entity, reflecting its origin as a generated scaffold.
